scripts.install: npm install --prefix services/api-gateway && npm install --prefix services/users-service && npm install --prefix services/events-service && npm install --prefix services/ticketing-service
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix services/api-gateway && npm run format --prefix services/users-service && npm run format --prefix services/events-service && npm run format --prefix services/ticketing-service
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix services/api-gateway && npm run lint --prefix services/users-service && npm run lint --prefix services/events-service && npm run lint --prefix services/ticketing-service
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix services/api-gateway && npm run build --prefix services/users-service && npm run build --prefix services/events-service && npm run build --prefix services/ticketing-service
scripts.seed: docker exec -it users-service npm run seed && docker exec -it events-service npm run seed
scripts.seed:users: docker exec -it users-service npm run seed
scripts.seed:events: docker exec -it events-service npm run seed
scripts.seed:ticketing: docker exec -it ticketing-service npm run seed
scripts.restart:build: npm run stop && npm run start:dev:build
